name: PPARG-associated Congenital Generalized Lipodystrophy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: PPARG-associated Congenital Generalized Lipodystrophy Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Near-total absence of subcutaneous adipose tissue from birth or early infancy
Identification of pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant in the PPARG gene
Presence of severe insulin resistance with diabetes mellitus or hypertriglyceridemia
Evidence of hepatic steatosis or hepatomegaly on imaging or biopsy
Presence of acanthosis nigricans in flexural areas

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of generalized lipodystrophy, a pathogenic PPARG variant, and metabolic complications such as insulin resistance or diabetes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is essential for definitive diagnosis. Clinical presentation may overlap with other lipodystrophy syndromes.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Generalized absence of subcutaneous adipose tissue
pathognomonic.notes: Near-total lack of body fat from birth or early infancy
searchTerms: very thin skin with no fat layer

pathognomonic.symptomName: Severe insulin resistance with early-onset diabetes mellitus
pathognomonic.notes: Often refractory to standard diabetes treatments
searchTerms: severe insulin resistance with early diabetes
early diabetes caused by insulin resistance
high insulin resistance leading to diabetes

common.notes: Fatty liver detected by imaging or biopsy
Hyperpigmented, velvety plaques commonly on neck and axillae
searchTerms: velvety skin patches in body creases

common.symptomName: Muscular hypertrophy due to fat loss
common.notes: Apparent muscular prominence from lack of subcutaneous fat
searchTerms: muscle enlargement due to fat loss
increased muscle bulk with fat reduction

common.notes: Relative leptin deficiency due to adipose tissue loss

occasional.symptomName: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) features in females
searchTerms: female hormonal imbalance with cystic ovaries

occasional.notes: Dilated or hypertrophic changes reported in some cases

searchTerms: protein in urine and kidney problems

rare.notes: Acute episodes reported in severe hyperlipidemia
searchTerms: inflammation of pancreas due to triglycerides

rare.notes: Bone density loss possibly related to metabolic abnormalities

laboratory: Elevated fasting glucose and insulin levels indicating insulin resistance
imaging: Hepatic steatosis on ultrasound or MRI
Absence of subcutaneous fat on whole-body MRI or DEXA scan
other: Muscular hypertrophy with prominent veins due to fat loss

distinguishingFeatures: Partial rather than generalized fat loss

redFlags: Early-onset severe insulin resistance with diabetes mellitus
Near-total absence of subcutaneous fat from birth or infancy
Severe hypertriglyceridemia with risk of pancreatitis
references: Garg A. Lipodystrophies. Am J Med. 2000;108(2):143-152.
Akinci B, et al. PPARG mutations in familial partial lipodystrophy: clinical and molecular features. J Clin Endocrinol Metab. 2008;93(2):549-555.
Orphanet: PPARG-associated congenital generalized lipodystrophy. ORPHA:696242.
